newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Chin Poon limit up on debut.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Chin Poon limit up on debut.

text.p: Taiwan's Chin Poon Industrial Co Ltd went limit up in late trade in its listing debut on Monday and brokers said they expected the honeymoon bounce to continue for two more sessions.
With 55 minutes left, Chin Poon had soared by the daily seven percent limit, or T$2.10, to T$32.10 on very low volume of just 1,000 shares traded.
Chin Poon is a leading maker of printed circuit boards.
"The overall market is not doing badly and the electronic sector in particular enjoys good fundamentals," said Chen Han-chung of Yungli Securities.
"Chin Poon should be able to ride the honeymoon bounce for two more days," Chen said.
Electronic shares received a boost last Tuesday from news that the semiconductor book-to-bill ratio in the United States had climbed to a new year high in September.
Monitor maker Shamrock Technology, which debuted in the Taiwan market on Friday, also rose the limit on Monday, its third consecutive limit-up.
